scope: local synthetic probes; no Strix scan, AI calls, or production data

results.detail: The same process_input called by the URL widget read and converted a synthetic server file outside the upload flow. Arbitrary text-file disclosure was not tested or established.

detail.detail: The URL path caused real server-side HTTP requests to a loopback service. No external or metadata service was contacted.

results.detail: Two synthetic uploads with the same extension in the same second used the same filename; Bob's bytes overwrote Alice's bytes.

detail.detail: Building Bob's store deleted Alice's stored meeting in the shared namespace.

results.detail: An untrusted transcript instruction reached the system-role message unchanged. This proves the prompt boundary weakness, not a successful jailbreak of the production model.
